correctness.rationale: The composition of two slope ±2 tent shears has exactly 16 canonical affine/wrap branches per step, hence all third-return fixed points are covered by 4096 length-three itinerary words including fold equalities. Each return linear part is determinant one, trace in {-98,-82,-34,-2,22,38,102,198} and never trace 2; thus I−M is nonsingular and there is at most one rational fixed point per word, excluding fixed arcs. Independent rational enumeration of all words and all ordered branch inequalities yields 177 admissible incidences, 100 distinct H³ points, four H fixed points, 96 primitive points in 32 3-cycles. Independently recomputed 16 cycles of derivative trace 102, eight -34 and eight -98, each regular with |tr|>2. The parity of M−I yields denominators dividing |2−tr|/2, so primitive points lie on 1/18 or 1/50 grids; inspected exact checker proves grid counts 28 and 76 intersecting at the four fixed points. The census is exhaustive for one map, not empirical time sampling.
